discoveredIssues.description: A guest-initiated cancel through the manage link does not set late_cancel (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-public-booking-service.ts:936-950 writes only cancelledBy='guest'), while the operator cancel path does (rsv-booking-service.ts:2747-2756). The cancellations report and the Guestbook lateCancels counter therefore reflect operator cancellations only. VAL-REPORT-006 is satisfiable operator-side, but milestone 10's VAL-PAY-036 expects the guest path to set late_cancel.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Mirror the operator late-cancellation wiring in the public manage-link cancel path, with a route test.

discoveredIssues.description: eraseGuestProfile scrubs waitlist entries and payment card refs but never clears rsv_notify_requests.contact_phone_e164 / contact_email_norm (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-guest-service.ts:1081; schema at packages/tenant-db/src/schema.ts:4351-4352), so an erased guest's notify-me row keeps their phone and email. No contract assertion requires the scrub and the code path predates this milestone.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Clear the notify-request contact fields (or cancel the request) inside the same erasure transaction and note it in the erasure design.

discoveredIssues.description: On the Cloudflare Workers runtime (production US node), an unresolvable Origin on /reservations/* answers 400 and a wrong-region Origin answers 409 region_mismatch with orgRegion (apps/tenant-api/workers/index.ts:307-312, workers/org-router.ts:313-333) instead of the uniform 404 required by VAL-ONLINE-024/025. The Node runtime (the contract's curl tool on 3007/3009) is compliant; the edge path is the inherited /careers/ pattern and discloses no guest data.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Orchestrator decision: either accept the platform behavior (documented in library/engine-notes.md) or make the org-router answer 404 for /reservations* prefixes.

suggestedChanges: Note that ESLint's jest-dom/prefer-enabled-disabled autofix is unsafe: on `expect((el as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true)` it removes `.disabled` and leaves unbalanced parentheses, producing a parsing error. Hand-correct the fix (use expect(el).toBeDisabled()) and re-lint.

The skill could say explicitly that a gate failing only on auto-fixable lint in test files is a permitted mechanical fix; record the original failing command/exit code in validatorsRun (e.g. a `note`) so the history is preserved even though the gate ends green.
Consider recording the review report paths in the synthesis schema example (a `reviewReports` array), since the orchestrator otherwise has to glob the reviews directory.
